job.purpose: ESOCTIE candles part 2 of 4: 1 minute candles of the three contracts of every development event, packed by S (minutes x tickers at most 9,000); development only.

stop_rules.note: three 429s in a row end the run; no retry around a refusal

job.notes: Requests 61 to 120 of the 240 built by esoctie.py build-candles from ESOCTIE_LISTS (2026-11-12T2031Z); split only to stay under the 200 MB a run cap (worst case about 2.75 MB an answer at 305 bytes a candle, so at most about 165 MB a part).
